name: Walnut Geometric Media Console
description: A long, low rectangular media console crafted from dark wood, likely walnut, featuring a striking three-dimensional geometric pattern on its front facade. The design is modern and sculptural.

name: Sculptural Wavy Wooden Bookshelf
description: A tall, narrow bookshelf featuring a distinctive sculptural design with undulating, wavy side panels crafted from dark-toned wood. It has four horizontally aligned shelves and a back panel made from a lighter-toned wood, creating a visual contrast. The unit appears freestanding, blending organic forms with functional storage.

name: Industrial Modern Metal and Faux Marble 4-Tier Shelving Unit
description: A contemporary four-tier shelving unit featuring a sturdy black metal frame and white faux marble shelves. The design is open-backed and minimalist, with a distinctive top section that includes a partial shelf, suggesting a modern or industrial aesthetic. The shelves provide ample storage or display space.

name: Two-Part Modular Oak Wood Shelving Unit with Bottom Cabinets
description: This is a tall, two-part modular shelving unit crafted from light-toned oak wood, featuring a subtle wood grain. Each section has three open shelves above two closed cabinets. The top shelf of each section has distinctive raised side and back edges, creating a tray-like appearance. The cabinet doors are flush, with small circular handles, and appear to be either hinged or on sliding tracks. The overall design is minimalist and contemporary, with clean lines. The unit rests on a recessed plinth base.

name: Modern Retail Display Shelf Unit with Integrated Lighting
description: A modern, free-standing retail display unit characterized by a bold blue frame and white shelving and cabinet components. It features two open display shelves, a lower three-door storage cabinet with rounded corners, and an illuminated header panel. The design is sleek and contemporary, optimized for commercial product presentation.

name: Black Minimalist Metal Display Shelving Unit
description: A tall, narrow, and rectangular shelving unit featuring five evenly spaced open shelves supported by a thin black metal frame. Its design is minimalist and contemporary, intended for display or modest storage.

name: Carved Wood Sideboard with Geometric Motif
description: A long, dark brown wooden sideboard featuring two hinged cabinet doors, each adorned with a three-dimensional geometric pyramid pattern. Between the doors are three vertically stacked drawers with brass pull knobs. The unit rests on two solid, recessed block bases, also made of wood. The overall aesthetic is classic with decorative elements.

name: Natural Pine Louvered Storage Cabinet
description: A tall, narrow storage cabinet featuring a louvered front panel and solid wood side panels, crafted from light-toned natural pine wood.

name: Sculptural Wooden Sideboard
description: A long, low wooden storage unit featuring a highly sculptural and abstract relief pattern across its entire facade. It is constructed from a light-colored, possibly bleached or limed wood, with visible graining that accentuates its organic design.

name: Rounded Edge Wooden Media Console
description: A long, low wooden media console featuring gracefully rounded corners and a continuous, sleek profile. It includes multiple storage compartments concealed by flush-fitting doors, all supported by a minimalist base frame that integrates seamlessly with the overall design.

name: Two-Tier Minimalist Wood and Metal Wall Shelf
description: A minimalist two-tier wall shelf featuring light wood shelves supported by white bent metal brackets.

name: Woven Rattan Outdoor Storage Chest on Casters
description: A rectangular outdoor storage chest featuring a woven rattan-look exterior, a hinged lid secured by a metal clasp, integrated black handles on the short sides, and four black caster wheels for mobility. The chest has a natural light brown color and a clean, contemporary design suitable for outdoor use.

name: Reeded Front Console Cabinet
description: A long, low, rectangular storage cabinet with a dark top and base, featuring light gray reeded or fluted textured front panels. A vertical wooden accent divides the two main compartments, and the cabinet is supported by two pairs of short, dark, cylindrical legs.

name: Contemporary Walnut Sideboard Cabinet
description: A long, low wooden cabinet, likely a sideboard or credenza, made from walnut wood. It features a minimalist design with four cabinet doors and distinct rounded edges on its top and side profiles, giving it a seamless, fluid appearance. The base is integrated into the side panels, creating a clean, plinth-like support.

name: Stacked Modular Storage Cabinet
description: Two distinct, trapezoidal storage units are stacked vertically. Each unit features an angled, off-white front panel with a cluster of three small, dark spherical knobs. The main body of each unit is a warm, matte orange/rust color with smoothly rounded edges. The top unit is slightly offset or rotated relative to the bottom one, creating a dynamic, sculptural form.

name: Light Wood Multi-Storage Cabinet with Shelves and Drawer
description: A tall, rectangular storage unit constructed from light-toned wood laminate, featuring a combination of open shelving, double-door cabinets, and a single drawer. The unit has a minimalist design with simple brushed metal pull handles.

name: Multi-tiered Wooden Floral Display Stand
description: A multi-tiered display stand crafted from light-toned wood, featuring four distinct platforms, each shaped like a blooming flower with overlapping petals. The platforms are supported by slender, rounded wooden stems of varying heights, one of which has an organic curve near its base. The design emphasizes natural wood aesthetics and a sculptural, botanical form.

name: Dark Wood Modern Stepped Bookshelf and Magazine Rack
description: A modern, dark-stained wood shelving unit featuring a distinctive stepped and cantilevered design. It comprises three flat shelves for stacked items and an upper backrest-like element that forms an angled slot, ideal for displaying magazines or larger books. The unit is supported by integrated L-shaped legs, presenting a minimalist aesthetic.

name: Contemporary Walnut Media Console with Curved Edges
description: A contemporary media console or TV stand crafted from dark-toned wood, featuring a long, low profile with distinctive rounded edges on the top and sides. The front comprises four cabinet doors, each with a subtle vertical plank or slatted texture. The console is supported by an integrated, continuous frame that forms short, bent-wood style legs, giving it a light, floating appearance. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and modern, emphasizing natural wood grain.

name: Mid-Century Modern Light Wood TV Stand with Sliding Doors
description: A light wood, mid-century modern style TV stand featuring a long, low profile, tapered legs, a central open shelf, and two sliding cabinet doors with integrated pulls.

name: Two-Tier Metal Wire Storage Shelving Unit
description: A two-tier, rectangular storage unit constructed entirely from silver-colored metal wire. The unit features an open grid design, forming both the shelves and the side panels, and rests on a minimalist U-shaped base. Its aesthetic is modern and industrial.

name: Rounded Solid Wood Bookshelf with Slat Back
description: A freestanding bookshelf crafted from solid wood, featuring a distinctive rounded frame and five open shelves. The back panel incorporates vertical wood slats, and the piece stands on integrated U-shaped legs, creating a sleek and modern aesthetic. The wood has a rich, medium-to-dark brown tone with visible grain.

name: Wooden Storage Cabinet with Fluted Columns and Woven Panels
description: A compact wooden storage cabinet featuring a light to medium brown wood finish. The top surface has a slightly rounded edge. The cabinet's facade includes two smaller drawers at the top, two larger drawers below them, and two hinged doors at the bottom. The fronts of all drawers and doors are inset with a light-colored woven material, possibly rattan or cane. The cabinet is flanked by decorative fluted columns on the upper half, which transition into plain, slightly tapered legs. Each drawer and door is fitted with a small, dark-toned metal knob handle. The overall design suggests a traditional or transitional aesthetic.

name: Solid Walnut Four-Drawer Chest of Drawers with Curved Fronts
description: A dark brown, four-drawer chest of drawers crafted from solid wood, likely walnut. It features distinctive convexly curved drawer fronts and matching integrated wooden knob pulls. The top surface and side edges are gently rounded, contributing to a soft, contemporary aesthetic. The piece is supported by a recessed plinth base, creating a clean, understated profile.

name: Carved Wooden Wall Shelf
description: A dark brown carved wooden wall shelf, featuring intricate leaf and scroll motifs underneath the flat top surface. The shelf is designed to be mounted on a wall, providing a decorative and functional surface for display.

name: Contemporary Walnut-finish Media Console with Slatted Sliding Doors
description: A contemporary media console or TV stand constructed from wood with a warm, medium-brown, walnut-like finish. It features a long, rectangular top surface, an open central compartment, and two storage compartments on either side, each concealed by a vertically slatted sliding door. The doors have simple black pull handles. The unit rests on a recessed base supported by four short, solid block legs.

name: Modern Sculptural Dark Wood Console Bookshelf
description: A long, low, three-tiered shelving unit crafted from dark-stained wood. The design incorporates distinctive semi-circular or curved vertical dividers that create an undulating, sculptural pattern between the shelves. The shelves and base have rounded edges, contributing to its modern aesthetic.

name: Blue-Grey Transitional Sideboard
description: A blue-grey painted wooden sideboard featuring three top drawers with dark cup pulls and three lower cabinet doors with round knobs. The cabinet doors are detailed with raised panels, and the entire unit rests on a plinth base, presenting a blend of classic and modern aesthetics.

name: White Melamine Open Bookcase with Adjustable Shelves
description: A tall, narrow white bookcase featuring five open shelves, constructed from white melamine or laminate particle board. The shelves appear to be adjustable using pegs that fit into pre-drilled holes along the side panels.

name: Modern Spiral Walnut and Glass Display Shelving Unit with Integrated Lighting
description: A tall, modern, freestanding spiral shelving unit featuring a dark walnut-toned wooden frame and five round, clear glass shelves. The wooden structure twists upwards in a continuous helix, with integrated LED lighting running along its inner edge, illuminating the shelves. The unit stands on a stable circular wooden base.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Chest of Drawers with Antiqued Brass Hardware
description: A traditional-style chest of drawers crafted from dark-stained wood, featuring five drawers arranged with two smaller ones at the top and three larger ones below. Each drawer front is accented with subtle molding, and they are fitted with antiqued brass knob pulls. The chest stands on four turned bun feet, and its base has a gently curved apron, contributing to its classic aesthetic. The overall finish is a deep, rich brown with visible wood grain.
